props.name: children
props.description:
Buttons rendered as one joined set, optionally with `ButtonGroup.Separator` between them.
Descendant `Button`, `ToggleButton`, and `CopyButton` children inherit the group's `size`,
`variant`, and `tone` unless they set their own.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: id
props.description: `id` attribute of the group root element, for example to reference it from `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: role
props.description:
ARIA role of the group root. Use `'toolbar'` only when you also provide the toolbar keyboard
behavior yourself; the group adds none.

props.name: size
props.description:
Size inherited by descendant `Button`, `ToggleButton`, and `CopyButton` children that do not
set their own. When omitted, each child uses its own default size.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Tone inherited by descendant buttons that do not set their own (both `tone` and `activeTone` of
a `ToggleButton`). It also colors `ButtonGroup.Separator`. When omitted, each child uses its
own default tone.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Variant inherited by descendant buttons that do not set their own (the unpressed `variant` of a
`ToggleButton`; `CopyButton` ignores `link`). When omitted, each child uses its own default,
such as `solid` for `Button` and `ghost` for `ToggleButton` and `CopyButton`.
